name: tokenomics-test-harness
description: Test harness for evaluating coding agent performance and cost against different models on software development tasks

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --footer:js="main().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });" --outfile=bin/tokenomics && chmod +x bin/tokenomics
scripts.report: node src/generate-manifest.js && node -e "console.log('\n📊 REPORT Dashboard URL: http://localhost:8080/REPORT.html\n')" && npx serve . -p 8080
